content: Books make a perfect gift. They offer the chance to introduce a friend or family member to a story or world you love and adventures you can share together. You can even use a book as a seed for future gift ideas by getting someone hooked on a series. Black Friday sales offer plenty of bargains on fantasy and sci-fi classics and recent genre standouts for anyone looking to get an early start on holiday shopping. Even if you’re just looking for some reading material for your vacation, you should check out the 10 best Black Friday book deals.
